gloss: to look back at; to get even with

forms.label: Past polite

forms.negative: {見返|みかえ}していませんでした

definitions.gloss: to look back at, to glance back
definitions.explanation: To turn around and look at someone or something, or to look at something again to review it.

definitions.gloss: to get even with, to prove someone wrong, to show them
definitions.explanation: To succeed and prove wrong those who doubted or looked down on you. A highly motivational usage implying vindication through achievement.

examples.english: She turned around and looked back.

examples.english: I looked over my notes again and noticed a mistake.

バカにした⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧たち⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見返|みかえ}したい。
examples.english: I want to prove wrong the people who made fun of me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}して→努力する：20201_doryokusuru⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧し、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見返|みかえ}した。
examples.english: I worked hard, succeeded, and proved everyone wrong.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 2 (to get even / prove someone wrong) is very common in motivational contexts. The pattern 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見返|みかえ}して⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ expresses determination to succeed and vindicate oneself. The て⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ ending adds a combative or defiant tone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見返|みかえ}して⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧: I'll show them (determined)
- ⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見返|みかえ}す: to prove everyone around you wrong
- ⟦メモ→メモ：00274_memo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見返|みかえ}す: to review one's notes
- ⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見返|みかえ}す: to look back on the past
- ⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見返|みかえ}す: to look back through photos
